Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ThermoPheno 0.2.0

Calibration consistent with the simulation

  • estimate_required_tt_from_observed() now accumulates each observed season with the same code and rules as simulate_one_year(), including the vernalization and dormancy rules for winter crops. New arguments: crop_type, winter_dormancy_temp, vernalization_required, vernalization_temp_min, vernalization_temp_max, vernalization_days_required, spring_regrowth_temp and accumulation = c("simulation", "raw"). The returned list also reports accumulation and crop_type.
  • In 0.1.1 the observed-calendar calibration summed raw thermal time. For winter crops with vernalization, that sum is larger than what the simulation accumulates over the same season, so the calibrated requirement was too high and simulated harvests were late or forced at the deadline. Calibrating a winter crop with crop_type = "winter" and the simulation’s rules corrects this. accumulation = "raw" reproduces the 0.1.1 values.
  • For summer crops, and for calls that do not set crop_type, results equal 0.1.1 up to floating-point rounding (about 1e-12 °C·day), because the calibration now adds daily values in the same order as the simulation.
  • estimate_required_tt(), simulate_one_year() and run_simulation() use one internal accumulator. Simulation results are unchanged; summer-crop estimate_required_tt() values can differ from 0.1.1 by floating-point rounding.

Validation

  • Reran the DWD validation with the same protocol and inputs. Winter wheat is now calibrated with its winter rules. Forced winter wheat harvests fell from 174 to 22 and failed seasons from 8 to 0. Winter wheat harvest MAE changed from 14.52 to 9.45 days. The 0.1.1 outputs are archived and compared in the validation article.
  • Added a calibration-period diagnostic (validation/diagnose_tt_consistency.R) and run comparison scripts.
  • Added round-trip, equality and raw-mode tests for calibration and simulation.

ThermoPheno 0.1.1

  • Documented the DWD validation workflow and its held-out evaluation.
  • Added an attributed daily weather example from a DWD station.
  • Extended tests for thermal-time boundaries, planting windows, input handling and simulation outcomes.

ThermoPheno 0.1.0

  • Initial formal R-package structure.
  • Added thermal-time functions: simple, capped, and triangular methods.
  • Added summer- and winter-crop simulation logic.
  • Added Shiny application launcher.
  • Added observed-calendar thermal-time calibration through estimate_required_tt_from_observed().
  • Added testthat unit tests and example weather/scenario data.
